verdict.rationale: Twenty's own docs name record enrichment as a capability: AI agents can "enrich records with data from external sources," and auto-enriching new contacts from external APIs is a listed workflow use case built from record-change triggers and HTTP request steps. However, enrichment depends on you supplying and wiring up an external data provider. There is no evidence of a built-in firmographic or contact data source that fills fields automatically. Missing for 10: native firmographic/contact data provider, out-of-the-box automatic enrichment of Company and Person fields without custom workflow or API setup, detail on which fields are enriched, independent or hands-on corroboration.
